convention: anthropics/skills/skill-creator evals.json — two kinds. `kind:"trigger"` fixtures carry `should_trigger` for description-optimisation (train/held-out trigger accuracy). `kind:"behavioural"` fixtures carry a `tier` (M/D/R) and `expectations[]` asserting the skill applies / reasons / declines correctly on a salvaged Reagent→re-frame.ui fixture input.
notes: Positives target Reagent-view→re-frame.ui prompts on an already-re-frame2 app (compiled views, reg-view→defview, deref-drop, adopt the experimental substrate). Negatives target the DIFFERENT v1→v2 events/subs/db migration (re-frame-migration), authoring on re-frame2 (re-frame2), greenfield (re-frame2-setup), live runtime (re-frame2-pair), and the first-class 'stay on Reagent' non-goal. Behavioural inputs are drawn from the shelved W1 migrator's golden fixtures; the M/D/R trio is the tier-coverage floor the bead requires.

evals.name: m-transform-defview-sub-lift
evals.prompt:
Convert this to re-frame.ui:
(defn price [amt cur] [:button {:on-click #(dispatch [:buy amt])} @(subscribe [:total])])
(defn app [] [:div [price 1 2]])
expectations: Rewrites the header to (ui/defview price [{:keys [amt cur]}] ...) — positional params become a destructured prop map (MIG-01).
Rewrites the call site atomically to [price {:amt 1 :cur 2}] in the same change (MIG-01).
Drops the deref: @(subscribe [:total]) becomes (sub [:total]) (MIG-02).
Lifts the handler: {:on-click #(dispatch [:buy amt])} becomes {:on-click [:buy amt]} (MIG-04).
Adds the require [re-frame.ui :as ui :refer [defview sub]] (MIG-24) and cites the MIG ids for each change.
Does NOT treat the event vector [:buy amt] or the query vector [:total] as hiccup to respell/spread.

evals.name: d-decide-form2-local-state
evals.prompt:
Migrate this Reagent view to re-frame.ui:
(defn dropdown [] (r/with-let [open? (r/atom false)] [:div {:on-click #(reset! open? true)} (when @open? [:ul])]))
expectations: Recognises Form-2 / with-let view-local state (MIG-16) and does NOT silently rewrite the view.
Reasons about the decision — is this PRODUCT state (→ app-db: an event + a sub, a dataflow change to name for the author) or EPHEMERAL UI state (→ the host-local `local`)?
If ephemeral, maps to `local`'s three-tuple: @open? → value, (reset! open? v) → (set! v), (swap! open? f) → (update! f) — and explicitly avoids (set! (f open?)) as last-write-wins.
Holds the WHOLE view until the decision is made (cardinal rule 2), rather than converting some sites and leaving others.
Does not reach into the dataflow layer itself; it names the reg-event/reg-sub for the author when app-db is the answer.

evals.name: d-route-ssr-static-vs-hydrate
evals.prompt:
Migrate this to re-frame.ui:
(ns app.render (:require [reagent.dom.server :as s]))
(defn render-page [] (s/render-to-string [app]))
expectations: Treats MIG-23 as a shipped SSR transform, NOT a decline — ui/render-static and ui/hydrate-root have shipped.
Routes by intent: a static-page (non-hydrating) render maps to (ui/render-static [app-root]) — the compiled counterpart of React's renderToStaticMarkup.
Names the SSR-then-hydrate path as the alternative and asks which the app wants: re-frame.ssr/hydrate! (state only, no :render-tree-fn) then ui/hydrate-root (Spec 011).
Keeps the caveat: views using refs/effects need ui/client-only (or restructure) for the pure server phase.
Does NOT hold the view as an unshipped capability gap.

evals.name: r-decline-reagent-introspection
evals.prompt:
Convert this view to re-frame.ui:
(defn thing [] [:div (str (r/current-component))])
expectations: Declines — Reagent component-introspection / scheduler calls have no compiled equivalent (MIG-35).
Warns that r/current-component still COMPILES after conversion and fails/returns nil at runtime, so the build gate will not catch it.
Keeps the view on Reagent, or restructures away from the introspection (props/children the view already receives; effect for next-tick/after-render).

evals.name: d-mig18-handler-split
evals.prompt:
Migrate this view to re-frame.ui:
(ns f (:require [re-frame.core :refer [dispatch]]))
(defn save-btn [] [:button {:on-click (fn [e] (.preventDefault e) (when @dirty? (dispatch [:save])))} "Save"])
expectations: Recognises MIG-18 — the handler is not one of the three clean shapes (mixed guard + dispatch), so it is a judgment call, not an automatic lift.
Routes the guarded dispatch to ui/event (a nil return means no dispatch — the guard expressed as data-with-a-filter), not a bare fn.
Notes that a converted defview has no ambient dispatch; imperative dispatch would go through (ui/dispatch-fn) in the view body.
Holds/decides the WHOLE view (the guard reads view-local state, coupling it to the MIG-16 state decision) — no half-migrated body.

evals.name: m-negative-bare-symbol-not-spread
evals.prompt:
Migrate to re-frame.ui:
(defn item [t] [:li t])
(defn lst [ts] [:ul (for [t ts] ^{:key t} [item t])])
expectations: Converts item and lst to ui/defview and moves ^{:key t} to a :key prop (MIG-07): [item {:key t :t t}].
Does NOT treat the bare symbol child in [:li t] as a props map — `t` is content, never (ui/spread t) (the bare-symbol trap).
Leaves the plain hiccup structure otherwise unchanged (MIG-14).

evals.name: d-mig17-lifecycle-rehome-unmount
evals.prompt:
Migrate this Reagent Form-3 view to re-frame.ui:
(ns app.editor (:require [reagent.core :as r] [reagent.dom :as rdom]))
(defn editor []
  (let [{:keys [dispatch]} (rf/capture-frame)]
    (r/create-class
     {:component-did-mount    (fn [this] (.focus (rdom/dom-node this)))
      :component-will-unmount (fn [_] (dispatch [:resource/release]))
      :reagent-render         (fn [] [editor-form])})))
expectations: Recognises MIG-17 Form-3 lifecycle and decomposes each body into host/DOM work vs domain work — a judgment call held WHOLE (cardinal rule 2), not an automatic rewrite.

Routes the host/DOM work (focus the node on mount) to (effect :connect …), with the body's RETURN value as the cleanup — a trailing (fn [] …), NOT the React useEffect shape (a setup fn that returns a cleanup fn), which compiles but silently never runs.

Recognises there is NO dispatch-at-unmount in native re-frame.ui: (ui/dispatch-fn) fails loud at disconnect with :rf.error/dispatch-disconnected (the leaked-listener law), so an effect cleanup is NOT a place to smuggle the domain release.

Re-homes the unmount domain work (the [:resource/release] dispatch) OUT of the view — to the causal events that end the resource's life — and names those events / the minting owner for the author (cardinal rule 5); the migrated view becomes a pure defview that owns no lease.

Mentions the view-declared (ui/lease …) only as the alternative for a genuinely view-scoped, unconditional resource (framework releases at teardown, no dispatch) — not for an app-minted / conditional / dynamically-keyed owner.
